subject: System Design
title: CAP Theorem in Practice
description: A fast breakdown of CAP Theorem in Practice for builders.

hook.text: A network split occurs between two data centers. Do you serve stale data or return errors?

buildup.text: The CAP theorem says during a partition, you must choose between consistency and availability.

discovery.text: CP systems like ZooKeeper refuse requests during partitions. AP systems like Cassandra serve stale data.

twist.text: In practice, partitions are rare. Most of the time you're choosing between consistency and latency, not availability.

climax.text: CAP is a framework for thinking about trade-offs, not a strict classification of databases.

punchline.text: During a partition: choose consistency or availability.

quiz.question: What does the CAP theorem say about network partitions?
options: You must choose between consistency and availability
You can have all three guarantees
